FN-DY2KNT-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 34
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/03/2023
Senate Bill 34 as introduced could decrease receipts to the State General Fund from reduction
of fines; decrease receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to
which court costs are deposited; and decrease the obligations of the State General Fund, district
attorneys, the Board of Pardons and Paroles, the Department of Corrections and community
corrections programs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons no
longer charged with and convicted of the offenses repealed in this bill.
